items.subject: A slim late-20s Spanish man in a dark 1961 suit and a mid-20s Spanish woman with set dark hair in a modest belted dress, meeting among dancing couples
items.action: The young man offers his hand to the young woman at the edge of the dance floor as couples turn around them
items.gaze_interaction: Both turn toward each other, her head slightly lowered, his shoulders leaning in with an open palm
items.setting: Ballroom of the Círculo de Bellas Artes, Madrid, 1961: tall columns, gilded mouldings, polished parquet, a small band on a raised stage
items.color_palette: Warm gold, ivory, deep burgundy, black suits, soft cream gowns
items.props_detail: A crystal chandelier glowing above the dance floor
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the edge of the dance floor
items.lighting: Warm evening chandelier light with soft glow on the parquet
items.mood: Soft golden haze, relaxed shoulders, couples swaying close in warm light
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: The same young Spanish couple as newlyweds: the man in a dark suit with a white boutonniere, the woman in a simple ivory wedding dress and short veil
items.action: The couple steps out of a church doorway as a few relatives toss rice
items.gaze_interaction: The couple walks arm in arm down the steps, her hand tucked into his elbow, looking toward the street
items.setting: Stone steps of a modest Madrid parish church, September 1962, a narrow street with period cars
items.color_palette: Granite grey, ivory, black, pale autumn blue sky
items.props_detail: A small bouquet of white flowers held against her dress
items.camera_angle: Slightly low angle from the street
items.mood: Even soft light, rice drifting in the air, relatives clustered close on the steps
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: Hundreds of Spanish emigrants of all ages in early-1960s travel clothes, filling the decks of a large white migrant liner
items.action: Emigrants crowd the rails as the liner prepares to sail for Australia
items.gaze_interaction: Most figures seen from behind and in profile, waving toward the quay; a few hold hats aloft
items.setting: A Spanish port quay in 1962, a migrant ocean liner with tall funnel moored beside cargo cranes
items.color_palette: White hull, rust, navy blue water, faded suits and dresses, pale sky
items.props_detail: Worn cardboard suitcases tied with string stacked at the gangway
items.camera_angle: Low angle from the quay toward the towering hull
items.mood: Bright open sky, crowded rails, handkerchiefs lifted against the breeze
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: The young Spanish couple, late 20s and mid 20s, seen from behind at the ship's rail
items.action: The couple stands together at the stern watching the open sea stretch ahead
items.gaze_interaction: Both face the horizon, her head resting against his shoulder, his arm around her waist
items.setting: Upper deck of a 1962 migrant liner at open sea, wooden deck planks and white railings
items.color_palette: Deep navy sea, white paint, weathered teak, faded cotton clothing
items.props_detail: A single small suitcase at their feet
items.mood: Endless empty horizon, two small figures leaning into each other against the wind
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: A mid-20s Spanish woman of slight build in a simple cotton dress and cardigan, beside her late-20s Spanish husband in shirtsleeves
items.action: She walks pressed close against her husband along the crowded deck, holding his arm tightly
items.gaze_interaction: Her face turned up toward him, body tucked into his side; he looks ahead toward the bow
items.setting: Crowded deck of a 1962 migrant liner, other emigrants soft in the background
items.color_palette: Faded blue, cream, weathered teak, pale sea light
items.props_detail: Her small handbag clutched against his sleeve
items.mood: Warm sun on their shoulders, her body leaning fully into his, steady forward stride
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: Two young Spanish couples from Madrid in their 20s and early 30s in sun-faded 1960s clothing; one man with a bandaged foot
items.action: The two couples share an evening meal around a small table outside a house
items.gaze_interaction: Leaning toward each other across the table, one woman laughing with head tilted back
items.setting: Veranda of a simple corrugated iron and wood house in Wittenoom, 1962, red dusty ground beyond
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, faded paint, warm brown shadows
items.props_detail: A shared pot and bottle of wine on an oilcloth-covered table
items.mood: Long warm shadows, chairs pulled close together, relaxed slouched postures
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: A thin 8-year-old Spanish boy in shorts and a sweat-damp cotton shirt
items.action: The boy sits in the narrow shade of a lifeboat on a sun-baked deck
items.gaze_interaction: Head tipped back against the bulkhead, cheeks flushed, damp hair stuck to his forehead
items.setting: Open deck of a 1962 migrant liner under a blazing sky
items.color_palette: Bleached white, hot ochre deck, deep blue sea, sun-faded cotton
items.props_detail: A lifeboat hanging from its davits casting a thin strip of shade
items.camera_angle: High angle from an upper deck
items.lighting: Harsh midday sun with hard short shadows
items.mood: Shimmering heat haze, a small figure folded into the only shade
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: An 8-year-old Spanish boy in short trousers and knee socks among his family of emigrants
items.action: The boy climbs the gangway onto the liner, holding his mother's hand
items.gaze_interaction: He looks upward at the towering hull, his free hand on the rope rail
items.setting: Port of Málaga quay, 1962, gangway rising to a white migrant liner
items.color_palette: White hull, rust, sea blue, dusty beige quay, faded travel clothes
items.props_detail: A small cardboard suitcase carried by his father ahead of him
items.camera_angle: High angle from the ship's deck looking down the gangway
items.mood: Steep gangway, small figure dwarfed by the hull, crowd pressing behind
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: A white migrant liner leaving the harbour of Málaga
items.action: The liner pulls away from the breakwater into open sea, trailing a long wake
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction toward the open horizon beyond the bow
items.setting: Málaga harbour 1962, lighthouse, breakwater and the city's hills behind
items.color_palette: Mediterranean blue, white hull, ochre city walls, pale sky
items.props_detail: A long white wake curving back toward the shore
items.camera_angle: High angle from the harbour hills
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: Vast calm sea, a single ship shrinking toward the horizon
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: Spanish emigrant families on deck, a boy among them, in sweat-darkened shirts and light dresses
items.action: The liner glides slowly through the Suez Canal while passengers fan themselves in the heat
items.gaze_interaction: Figures seen from behind and in profile, staring out at the sand banks; the boy wipes his brow
items.setting: Suez Canal 1962, flat desert banks close on both sides, palms and a distant signal post
items.color_palette: Blinding sand, pale turquoise water, bleached white deck, faded clothing
items.props_detail: Improvised paper fans and a canvas awning sagging over the deck
items.camera_angle: Eye-level from the deck toward the bank
items.mood: Heat shimmer over the sand, slumped shoulders, damp clothes clinging to backs
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: A Spanish mother in her 30s and an 8-year-old boy, pale and sweating, in a cramped cabin
items.action: The seasick boy lies curled on a narrow bunk while his mother sits beside him
items.gaze_interaction: The mother turned away toward the porthole, shoulders drawn up; the boy hunched with eyes half closed
items.setting: Small below-deck cabin of a 1962 migrant liner, metal bunks, riveted walls
items.color_palette: Dull steel grey, faded green paint, sickly yellow porthole light
items.props_detail: A tin basin on the floor beside the bunk
items.lighting: Single shaft of daylight through a porthole into dim cabin
items.mood: Close stale air, a figure small in the dim, tilting horizon in the porthole
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: A small twin-propeller passenger plane of the early 1960s
items.action: The plane buffets through turbulent air over the desert, wings tilting
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the wing toward the red ground far below
items.setting: Sky over the Pilbara desert, Western Australia, 1962
items.color_palette: Dusty blue sky, silver aluminium, deep red earth below
items.props_detail: A spinning propeller blur on the wing
items.camera_angle: Low angle from below the plane
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, telephoto compression
items.mood: Rough hazy air, the small plane tilted against an immense empty sky
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: The small propeller plane and a few Spanish families stepping down onto the strip
items.action: The plane rolls to a stop on the airstrip, raising a huge cloud of dust
items.gaze_interaction: Figures seen from behind shielding their eyes against the swirling dust
items.setting: Wittenoom airstrip 1962, a bare strip of grey-blue surfaced ground amid vast red Pilbara earth and low ochre hills
items.color_palette: Deep red earth, ochre hills, grey-blue strip surface, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: A billowing cloud of dust trailing behind the propellers
items.camera_angle: Low angle from the edge of the strip
items.mood: Dust hanging in hot still air, figures small and squinting against the glare
items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: An 8-year-old Spanish boy, dust-coated, standing small before a row of active 1962 company houses
items.action: The boy halts on a dusty road facing the town of houses he is being led to
items.gaze_interaction: Seen from behind, head tilted up toward the houses, dust settling on his shoulders
items.setting: Wittenoom 1962, a row of inhabited houses of corrugated iron, wood and asbestos cement sheeting, red dust over everything
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, faded grey sheeting, rusted iron, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A battered company truck unloading family luggage
items.mood: A small figure facing a hot dusty street, haze softening the rooflines
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings heaped below the mine and mill, a few dust-covered miners in work trousers and shirts nearby
items.action: The mill pours fibrous waste onto the growing heap while dust drifts across the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: Miners seen from behind walking past the heap toward the mill, focus on the tailings
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge mine and mill 1962, red rock walls, corrugated iron mill buildings and conveyors
items.color_palette: Red rock, ochre, grey-blue tailings, rusted iron, hazy blue sky
items.props_detail: A rattling conveyor belt feeding the heap
items.camera_angle: Low angle up toward the mill
items.lighting: Harsh midday desert sun filtered through dust
items.mood: Thick dust haze, tiny figures beneath an industrial heap
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: A newly arrived Spanish family: a late-20s father, a mid-20s mother and an 8-year-old boy, clothes already powdered with dust
items.action: The family walks down a street surfaced with grey-blue tailings, the boy kicking up dust as he goes
items.gaze_interaction: The boy looks down at the dust swirling around his shoes; parents look ahead toward their house
items.setting: Wittenoom residential street 1962, corrugated iron houses, tailings-covered road and yards
items.color_palette: Grey-blue dust, red earth, ochre, faded sheeting, pale dusty sky
items.props_detail: The boy's dusty leather sandals stirring a small cloud
items.mood: Fine dust hanging in still bright air, small figures walking unhurried through the haze
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
